subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
12. The following information pertains to a worker G:
Basic Pay
` 25,000 per month
Dearness Allowance
` 5,000 per month
Other Allowances
` 2,000 per month

6

The number of working days in a year is 325 of 8 hours each. G has availed
25 days as holidays on full pay in a year.

What is the wage rate per hour of worker G?
(A)  ` 160
(B)  ` 175
(C)  ` 140
(D)  ` 185
(2 Marks)
